# reference-links-images

- ID: `MD052`
- Category: Links and images
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `images`, `links`

Labels in \[text\]\[label\] and \[label\]\[\] references are defined, except x.

## Why

A reference with an undefined label renders as plain text in brackets. Shortcut
references such as \[label\] are not checked, because plain text in brackets
looks the same. The label x is ignored because task lists use \[x\].

## Options

Set them under `rules.reference-links-images.options`.

- `ignored_labels` (`string[]`, default `[x]`): Labels that need no definition.
  The default, x, keeps task list items such as \[x\] from being reported.
- `shortcut_syntax` (`boolean`, default `false`): Check shortcut references,
  such as \[label\], too.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Only the author knows the missing destination.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

Read the [installation guide][install] first.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:10 Reference link uses undefined label [install]
```

This document follows the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

Read the [installation guide][install] first.

[install]: docs/install.md
```

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  reference-links-images:
    options:
      ignored_labels: [x]
```

Under `rules`, `reference-links-images: false` turns the rule off and
`reference-links-images: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable reference-links-images` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line reference-links-images -->
```
